title: Hollowmere
description:
a town lost in the fog, where empty eyes hide darker truths and whispers echo behind locked doors.
One night, a desperate message reaches you from someone trapped inside. The town is consuming its people, one by one. But who can you trust when no one is what they seem?
You’ll talk. You’ll listen. You’ll choose. Every decision brings you closer to the truth… or deeper into Hollowmere.
**Save them before you become one of the lost.**
features: Your Choices Decide Who Survives: Every message matters, one wrong word could seal your fate.
Uncover the Town’s Dark Secrets: Explore hidden truths and face what the people of Hollowmere tried to bury.
Chat with the Lost: Every conversation brings you closer to the one who called for help… or to becoming the next lost soul.
how_to_play:
Read & Respond: Experience the story through interactive chat messages.
Make Choices: Your decisions shape the story and lead to different outcomes.
Uncover Clues: Find hidden details, solve puzzles, and piece together the mystery.
Interact with Characters: Talk to various characters and discover their secrets.
